notes: could not is split between יָכֹל and לֹא under rule 35, since the ASV wrote two words rather than a fused cannot.
צוּר עַל rendered as a bare transitive leaves עַל unrepresented under rule 40, which cites this very construction.
The him of overcome him is added: the Hebrew writes only לְהִלָּחֵם with no object morpheme, and rule 44 refuses to fold a supplied object into the verb.
